summary: TETRA Technologies filed an 8-K to disclose the pricing of an underwritten public offering of 10,810,811 shares of common stock at $9.25 per share, expected to yield net proceeds of ~$94 million for general corporate purposes including the Arkansas bromine project. J.P. Morgan Securities acted as representative of underwriters. The offering is an ordinary equity capital raise under an existing effective shelf registration, not a special situation event. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The 30-day over-allotment option for up to 1,621,621 additional shares and a customary lock-up are noted. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a transformative event.
